translations.text: In many portions and in many ways, God spoke long ago to our ancestors through the prophets.
For to which of the angels did God ever say, “You are my Son; today I have fathered you”? And again, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son.”
And free those who, through fear of death, were held in slavery all their lives.
Therefore, my holy brothers, who have been called with a calling from heaven, consider Jesus Christ, the apostle and high priest of our confession.
Do not harden your hearts and provoke him, as those who rebelled did, and as on the day of testing in the wilderness,
where your ancestors tested me and put me to the proof, and saw my deeds for forty years.
As it is said, “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts and provoke him.”
Since, then, there was room for some to enter it, and those who first received the good news did not enter because they did not obey,
If the Lord permits, we will do this.
So that through two things that do not change, in which God cannot lie, we who have taken refuge in him may have great encouragement and hold on to the hope promised to us.
It is a very fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
Therefore, endure discipline, because God treats you as sons. For what son is there whom his father does not discipline?
Therefore, strengthen your limp hands and trembling knees.

Therefore, take care not to refuse the one who speaks to you. For if those who refused the one who spoke to them on earth did not escape, how much less will we escape if we refuse the one who speaks to us from heaven?
His voice shook the earth. But now he has promised, saying, “Once more I will shake not only the earth but also heaven.”
And do not forget compassion and sharing with the poor, for through such sacrifices a person pleases God.
Know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he comes soon, I will see you with him.
